legend.ok: setup + alg reaches the goal (trailing AUF / rotation allowed), against a setup that is the site's own or matches the site's drawing, or that another alg of the entry was not derived from
legend.unverified: reaches the goal, but only against a setup made from its own inverse (the converter's setup for the main alg, or the stand-in for an unparsable site setup) that no drawing confirms
legend.preAuf: reaches the goal only with an AUF before the alg; "auf" says which
legend.preRotation: reaches the goal only when the puzzle is first held from another side
legend.preRotationAuf: reaches the goal only with both a rotation and an AUF before the alg
legend.wrong: parses, but setup + alg does not reach the goal from any angle
legend.badSetup: not judged: the entry's setup failed its start or image check (see the entry's badStart / imageMismatch issue)
legend.unparsable: cubing.js cannot parse it for this puzzle
legend.parseOnly: category not simulated (no goal); only parsed
legend.engineMangled: expandNotation() + cleanAlgorithmForCubing() turn it into a different (or unparsable) alg
legend.badStart: entry: the setup state is not a legal start for the category
legend.setupUnparsable: entry: the site's setup does not parse on this puzzle; the inverse of the entry's first parsable alg stands in for it (setupIsFallback)
legend.unverifiedMain: see unverified; listed per entry with the reason
legend.imageMismatch: entry: the setup state does not look like the site's drawing of the case
legend.trivialSetup: entry: the setup state already meets the goal, so its algs are not tested
legend.mainFails: entry: the main alg does not solve the setup state as written; "firstOkAlternative" does
legend.mainDisagrees: entry: the main alg passes but every alternative fails, so the main alg and setup are suspect
legend.betterSetup: entry: no check failed, but another setup (inverse of one of its algs) is solved by more of its algs
legend.suggestedSetup: entry: a setup (inverse of one of its algs) that passes the failed checks

totalsLegend.ok … parseOnly: algs per status (every alg of every entry counts once)
totalsLegend.engineMangled: algs the trainer would play differently
totalsLegend.startChecked: entries whose category has a start goal; startOk / badStart split them
totalsLegend.imageChecked: entries with one site drawing (jcube) on 3x3, 2x2 or 4x4; imageOk / imageMismatch split them
totalsLegend.setupFallback: entries simulated with the inverse of an alg because the site setup does not parse
totalsLegend.mainFails: entries whose main alg does not solve its setup as written
totalsLegend.suggestedSetup: entries with a suggestedSetup issue (badStart, imageMismatch or betterSetup)
